title: RCKT
info: After starting its career as Rocket Company* since 1996, the creative production RCKT was officially established as an independent company in 1999. Mainly targeting on fashion/culture industry. RCKT offers planning and production of advertisements, editing magazines and books, planning and coordination of special events.
